{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-q4fj","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-2auf.44.7.1: lichen-node node.rs missing NotAdmitted handling for DaoProcessError","description":"## Location
`rust/lichen-node/src/node.rs:369-377` and `rust/lichen-node/src/node.rs:72-86`

## Problem
`DaoProcessError` gained a `NotAdmitted` variant in `lichen-rpl` but the `lichen-node` crate was not updated:

1. The exhaustive match in `handle_verified_dao()` (lines 369-377) maps `DaoProcessError` variants to `DaoHandlingOutcome` but has no arm for `NotAdmitted`.
2. The `DaoHandlingOutcome` enum (lines 72-86) has no `NotAdmitted` variant.

## Impact
Compilation failure — Rust requires exhaustive matching. When `process_signature_verified` returns `Err(DaoProcessError::NotAdmitted)`, it propagates through `process_signature_verified_dao_from_at_ms` (via `?` operator) and reaches the match in `handle_verified_dao`.

## Fix
1. Add `NotAdmitted` variant to `DaoHandlingOutcome` enum
2. Add `Err(DaoProcessError::NotAdmitted) => DaoHandlingOutcome::NotAdmitted` arm to the match at line 376
3. Update any consumers of `DaoHandlingOutcome` that exhaustively match on it (e.g. `rpl_stack.rs:1312-1315`)","status":"open","priority":0,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T16:57:05.320790284Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T16:57:05.320790284Z"}
